about: Calibration for scripts/digitize_bayer_fig11.py: how pixels in Figure 11 of the CSB Bayer CropScience report map to time and values. Every number here was read off the figure's own axes, gridlines and tick marks; the report's text values are NOT used to calibrate, only to check (see 'checks').

source.report: U.S. Chemical Safety Board, Investigation Report: Pesticide Chemical Runaway Reaction Pressure Vessel Explosion, Bayer CropScience, LP, Institute, West Virginia, August 28, 2008. Report No. 2008-08-I-WV, January 2011.
source.figure: Figure 11. Residue treater process variables before the explosion (report page 39, PDF page 47)
source.reuse: The figure itself is not stored in this repository; the script fetches the report and reads it at run time. Only digitized values (facts, each cited to this figure) are committed.

annotation_boxes._comment: Black text and arrows inside the plot that are not the pressure trace: excluded from the black series. [x0, y0, x1, y1] in image pixels.
